In [[43 ABY]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] used '''small quarters''', typical of chambers afforded to senior [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and those [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] not on the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]]. Small and spartan like all personal chambers in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]], they afforded more peace then the [[Jedi Temple dormitory|Temple dormitories]] reserved for the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] and younger Knights.

The room contained a small bed, along with a desk where Jaina could study or perform her research projects. It was here that Jaina first was re-introduced to her new [[Jedi supervisor]], [[Dab Hantaq]]. Taken aback by his similarities to her dead brother [[Anakin Solo]], she was increasingly uncomfortable when she ordered him to sit, though she was sitting in the room's only seat.
